source.label: mtg-jp.com coverage, エターナル・ウィークエンド・アジア2019 ヴィンテージ選手権 トップ８デッキリスト

notes.text: mtg-jp prints card names in Japanese (Power, duals and other old cards in English); `name` is the English name, checked against Scryfall and mtg-jp's own English export, and `printed_as` the Japanese as printed. Every list matches mtgtop8's English copy card for card.
mtg-jp orders the Top 8 by Swiss rank (the seeds here) and gives no archetypes; archetypes are mtgtop8's. 1st and 2nd are from the final report (Tanigawa beat Kitano).
The semifinalists are unresolved: mtgtop8 has 3rd Kusakawa and 4th Kato (with Jumonji 8th), MTG Wiki (ja) has 3rd Kato and 4th Jumonji. mtgtop8's pair is used, as 3-4.
128 registered and 125 played (mtg-jp metagame breakdown); mtgtop8 says 128.
